ios.desc:
Connect with people you would never meet otherwise.
Join and create events from 200+ activities ranging from surfing, tennis, hikes to dinner.
Set your events to “Visible” to meet new people or “Connections only” to stay with your friends.

EVENTS - All your events are private. You choose who can see them:
• Accept or decline participants
• Create single gender events to stay with your kin.
• Secret events are for your most private gatherings
• Events have a group chat, a date, location, photos and more

PEOPLE - Everyone here is active, fit and outgoing!
• Connect with people you would never have met otherwise
• Filter by activities and levels
• With premium, filter by age, gender, relationship status and location

SAFETY - Stay safe at all time
• Only people that joined your event can see its exact location.
• Your exact location is never shared with other users.
• Reciprocity: both parties must accept a friendship.
• Hide people you’d rather not see.

EARN MONEY - Create an event and sell tickets or allow tips
• Apply become a paid host
• Set a ticket price
• Or allow participants to tip at the end of an event, depending on your suggested price.

People around the world hangout, meet and create memories thanks to Axir.
Give us feedback at axir@axirapp.com
